method: Exact (Pedigree, Year, Field-Location, Grain Yield numeric value) gives one source row for every formal record. Source CSV line numbers include header. This is a provenance join, not a statistical aggregation.
remaining: 原始 hybrid genotype 数值的构建来源、亲本组合规则和 marker 参考坐标仍未绑定；现有数值保留。原天气 day 实为 DOY，字段与播种日期可核对，不把原窗口默认为 DAP。

limits: Source cleaning README has 2020 header but 2021 maintenance dates; retain original ambiguity.
NEH2 and NEH3 have distinct field-station coordinates despite the shared official weather label; do not infer physical colocation.
Shared weather labels imply dependent environmental predictors; validation must disclose this dependence.
No claim that every weather variable/day is non-missing; raw blanks retained.

revision_notes: 修订版 20261020-fullanalysis。895行正式表型都绑定原始小区Plot_ID，不能按sample×environment去重；拟合用组合的等权均值并保留n_plot。257行block原缺失不填造。天气来源为G2F2021，27环境通过官方映射连接24个天气标签；原小时/站点记录保留。weather_daily是同标签同日非缺失温度等权均值，window_coverage是DOY150..230的有效日均值及覆盖率。覆盖>=80%采用25环境；旧environment_timeseries只审计，不叠加。共享天气源按source_group整组留出；全缺失基因型标记必须在训练折内删除，其他插补/缩放只拟合训练数据。基因型分数保留为原给定数值特征；未重新验证亲本推导过程。窗口不是每个材料真实生育期。天气只作为GxE环境协变量。本版要完成反应规范及两类验证。
